targets.query:
index="index_sit1_exch_k8s" "kubernetes.container_name"="rtr-mock-api-sit1" | where like(message, "%pacs.008%")
| eval log_without_backslashes = replace(_raw, "\\\\", "")
| rex field=log_without_backslashes "\"financial_institution_identification\"\s*:\s*\{\s*\"financial_institution_identification\"\s*:\s*\{\s*\"clearing_system_member_identification\"\s*:\s*\{\s*\"member_identification\"\s*:\s*\"(?<csp>[^\"]+)\""
| rex field=log_without_backslashes "\"transaction_status\"\s*:\s*\"(?<status>[^\"]+)\""
| rex field=log_without_backslashes "\"instructing_agent\"\s*:\s*\{\s*\"financial_institution_identification\"\s*:\s*\{\s*\"clearing_system_member_identification\"\s*:\s*\{\s*\"member_identification\"\s*:\s*\"(?<sendingParticipant>[^\"]+)\""
| rex field=log_without_backslashes "\"instructed_agent\"\s*:\s*\{\s*\"financial_institution_identification\"\s*:\s*\{\s*\"clearing_system_member_identification\"\s*:\s*\{\s*\"member_identification\"\s*:\s*\"(?<receivingParticipant>[^\"]+)\""
| timechart span=15m count by status
| addtotals
